capability.title: Signature Dish Carousel
capability.description: Autoplaying, horizontally scrollable carousel of signature dishes, each with a photo, optional tag, name, description, and price, plus an optional link to more.
useWhen: Several signature dishes should be browsed one at a time or side by side
A moving showcase of menu highlights with prices is wanted above a link to the full menu
avoidWhen: Every item must stay visible at once
The items have no photo or price
